scope: Build ordinary and independently reviewed direct-proof Perl, Python, Ruby and Rust packages twice; retain receipt-closed offline archives and Rust dependencies; prove every generated API exposes one UInt32 payload and no proof slot; execute each installed caller; relocate complete installations; and reject attempted proof arguments in the host interpreter or compiler.

edits.current:
- name: Qualify direct proof erasure in prepared language packages
        if: matrix.profile == 'python' || matrix.profile == 'rust'
        id: direct_proof_language
        continue-on-error: true
        timeout-minutes: 100
        run: bash scripts/run-direct-proof-erasure-language-ci.sh "${{ matrix.profile }}"
      - name: Preserve direct proof-erasure language acceptance
        if: always() && (matrix.profile == 'python' || matrix.profile == 'rust')
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: direct-proof-erasure-language-${{ matrix.profile }}-${{ github.sha }}
          path: build/direct-proof-erasure-language-ci/${{ matrix.profile }}/
          if-no-files-found: error
          overwrite: true
          retention-days: 30

edits.current:
- name: Qualify direct proof erasure in the prepared Perl package
        if: matrix.configuration == '5.38.2-threaded'
        id: direct_proof_language
        continue-on-error: true
        timeout-minutes: 100
        env:
          DIRECT_PROOF_PERL_CONFIGURATION: ${{ matrix.configuration }}
        run: |
          export LEAN_BRIDGE_CORPUS_PERL="$PWD/.toolchains/perl/$DIRECT_PROOF_PERL_CONFIGURATION/bin/perl"
          bash scripts/run-direct-proof-erasure-language-ci.sh perl
      - name: Preserve direct proof-erasure Perl acceptance
        if: always() && matrix.configuration == '5.38.2-threaded'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: direct-proof-erasure-language-perl-${{ github.sha }}
          path: build/direct-proof-erasure-language-ci/perl/
          if-no-files-found: error
          overwrite: true
          retention-days: 30

- name: Enforce direct proof-erasure Perl support
        if: always() && matrix.configuration == '5.38.2-threaded' && steps.direct_proof_language.outcome != 'success'
        run: exit 1
